BillHeading.BriefDescription: Allowing the sale of wine by snack bar license holders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing the sale of wine by snack bar license holders; and amending RCW 66.24.350.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 66.24.350 and 1997 c 321 s 20 are each amended to read as follows:Snack bar license—Fee.
BillSection.P: There shall be a beer retailer's license to be designated as a snack bar license to sell beer by the opened bottle or can at retail or wine by the glass at retail, for consumption upon the premises only, such license to be issued to places where the sale of beer is not the principal business conducted; fee one hundred twenty-five dollars per year.
